Namespace: [Ankus.Serialization](/api/ankus.serialization/)

Assembly: `Ankus.Runtime.dll`

Writes intervals as session-independent ISO 8601 strings and reads every PostgreSQL interval input form.

```csharp
public sealed class PgIntervalConverter : JsonConverter<PgInterval>
```

Writing never requires a backend. The exact ISO 8601 form written here is also read without a backend;
other text, including infinity, uses PostgreSQL interval input on the active backend.

Inheritance: [object](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.object), [JsonConverter](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.text.json.serialization.jsonconverter), [JsonConverter&lt;PgInterval&gt;](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.text.json.serialization.jsonconverter-1)
